format_methodlong <- function(method, NC_type, numNC) {
  if(method == 'lmYA' )     {return("Lin Reg")}
  if(method == 'lmYAU')     {return("Lin Reg (w/ confounders)")}
  if(method == 'poisYA')    {return("Pois")}
  if(method == 'poisYAU')   {return("Pois (w/ confounders)")}
  if(method == 'negbinYA')  {return("Neg Bin")}
  if(method == 'negbinYAU') {return("Neg Bin (w/ confounders)")}
  
  if(method == '2SLSpci2s') {
    if(       NC_type == 'proximalNegBinCountCount') {
      NC_type_short = 'Neg Bin Y w/ count gene NCs'
    } else if(NC_type == 'proximalNegBinSinglegeneSinglegene') {
      NC_type_short = 'Neg Bin Y w/ continuous gene NCs'
    } else if(NC_type == 'proximalNegBinPCAPCA') {
      NC_type_short = 'Neg Bin Y w/ continuous PCA NCs'
    } else {
      NC_type_short = NC_type
    }
    return(sprintf('Proximal: %s (#NC=%d)', NC_type_short, numNC))
  }
}


# source(sprintf('%s/AY/proximal_continuous_settings.r', save_dir)) # loads in list: proximal_continuous_settings

# construct the ordering
method_long_paste  =  c('lmYANANA', 'lmYAUNANA')
method_long_order  =  c('Lin Reg', 'Lin Reg (w/ confounders)')
method_long_colors =  colorRampPalette(c('white', NC_base_colors[['lm']]))(8)[c(4, 8)]
for(NC_name in NC_names_chosen) {
  # proximal_setting = readRDS(sprintf('%s/AY/%s/%s/proximal_setting.rds', save_dir, AYZW_setting_name, NC_name))
  # proximal_setting = proximal_continuous_settings[[NC_name]]
  # cur_numNCs = proximal_setting$num_NC_pairs
  # if only select a few numNCs, select that here
  all_cur_numNCS =  effects_continuous |> filter(NC_type == NC_name) |> pull(numNC) |> unique() |> sort()
  if(use_all_numNC) {
    cur_numNCs = all_cur_numNCS
  } else {
    cur_numNCs = intersect(chosen_numNC_subset[[NC_name]], all_cur_numNCS)
  }
  
  
  colors_to_add = colorRampPalette(c('white', NC_base_colors[NC_name]))(length(cur_numNCs) + 1)[-(1)]
  method_long_names_to_add = c()
  for(numNC_1 in cur_numNCs) {
    method_long_names_to_add = c(method_long_names_to_add, format_methodlong('2SLSpci2s', NC_name, numNC_1))
  }
  
  method_long_paste  = c(method_long_paste, paste0('2SLSpci2s', NC_name,cur_numNCs))
  method_long_order  = c(method_long_order, method_long_names_to_add)
  method_long_colors = c(method_long_colors, colors_to_add)
  rm( method_long_names_to_add, colors_to_add)
}
names(method_long_colors) = method_long_order

#' convert NC_type to the current method_i, if NC_type is NA and method_i is lmYA or lmYAU
fn_turn_NC_type_lm <- function(NC_type_i, method_i) {
  if(is.na(NC_type_i) && method_i %in% c('lmYA', 'lmYAU')) {return(method_i)}
  else {return(NC_type_i)}
}
effects_continuous$NC_type = mapply(FUN = fn_turn_NC_type_lm,
                                    NC_type_i = effects_continuous$NC_type, 
                                    method_i = as.character(effects_continuous$method)) |> unname()
effects_continuous = effects_continuous |> mutate(NC_type = factor(NC_type, levels = c('lmYA', 'lmYAU', NC_names_chosen)))
